notes: Updates now also refresh README.txt next to the game (from this version's next update on). No gameplay changes.
Updated README.txt: explains intertwined roots, the three spell designer tiers and the quick cast option. No gameplay changes.

Roots part 2: intertwine two roots (Character > Roots, at the spell altar) into one of ten new elements, like Frostfire, Blood, Prism or Armament, each with its own special effect. The spell designer's Tier 3 is where you make spells of them. Everyone in a lobby needs this version.

Mouse controls: right click to move, left click to use the terminal / spell altar and to revive. Ten spell slots on 1-5 and Q-T. Spell preview hologram with exact paths and areas, and a quick cast option. The spell designer now opens at the spell altar on the training ground. Your old key settings are reset to the new layout.

Mage stats: Intelligence, Wisdom, Spirit, Willpower, Focus and Vigor, bought with essence in Character (F2) > Stats, with a paid respec. Element roots: develop any of the five with essence for stronger, cheaper spells of that element. Mix traits now work in play (Steam scalds, Lightning chains, Ice freezes, Sand blinds and more). Your gear is converted to the new stats on the first start. Players on older versions cannot join 0.1.4 lobbies: everyone updates.

Settings (Esc > Settings): window mode and resolution, vsync, text size, start zoom, damage numbers and rebindable keys. Updates are now signed: from this version on the game only installs updates signed with the release key. Spell bar cooldowns no longer cover the mana cost; the allied dummies moved clear of the spell bar.

Save failsafes: safe saving with a previous-save copy, daily backups (newest 5), automatic recovery from an interrupted or damaged save, and nothing in a save is ever dropped. Your 0.1.x profile is upgraded on the first start (the old file is kept as .bak). Do not go back to 0.1.0 or 0.1.1 afterwards: they cannot read the new format.
Update test: checks that the in-game updater moves 0.1.0 players to a new version. No gameplay changes.
First shipping version: spell designer (tiers 1 and 2), three zones and the Hollow Warden, co-op lobbies for up to 4 players, auto-updater.
